{"metadata":{"description":"用于监控当前会话额度消耗、预估费用及当前API余额/Used to monitor the current session's quota consumption, estimated costs, and current API balance.","id":"gh:1333972690","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-client-ui-monitor","slug":"Auran-Lu/dsh-client-ui-monitor","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"用于监控当前会话额度消耗、预估费用及当前API余额/Used to monitor the current session's quota consumption, estimated costs, "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"and current API balance."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @auranlu/dsh-client-ui-monitor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that pins a usage dashboard to the bottom-left of the sidebar."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It shows, live for the current session:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Token usage** — input (with cache read/write), output.
- **Estimated cost** — computed from Deep"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"Seek's published pricing, displayed in CNY or USD.
- **API balance** — your DeepSeek account balance"},{"id":"p6s3","text":", queried via `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Features: Chinese/English toggle, currency selector (CNY/USD), manual balance refresh, auto-refresh "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"Chinese/English toggle, currency selector (CNY/USD), manual balance refresh, auto-refresh every 30s."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `web` profile.
- A DeepSeek API key configured in **Settings → Models** (stored a"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Method 1 — GitHub"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**After installing**, register the plugin and restart:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` and add this entry to its top-level array:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then restart the server (`dsh web`) and expand the left sidebar."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Method 2 — one-sentence install (paste to an LLM agent)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Copy the whole block below to a coding agent that has shell access to the machine:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Install the DeepSeek Harness client plugin from github.com/Auran-Lu/dsh-client-ui-monitor: run `ds"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"h plugin --profile web add github:Auran-Lu/dsh-client-ui-monitor`, then append this entry to the top"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"-level array of `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":">
> Finally restart the `dsh web` server and confirm the dashboard appears at the bottom of the left"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ly restart the `dsh web` server and confirm the dashboard appears at the bottom of the left sidebar."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Edit `lib/client.js` before installing / publishing:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Constant | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `PRICING.inputPerM` | `0.27` | USD per 1M prompt tokens (cache miss) |
| `PRICING.cacheReadPerM` |"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" `0.07` | USD per 1M prompt tokens (cache hit) |
| `PRICING.cacheWritePerM` | `0.07` | USD per 1M pr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ompt tokens (cache write) |
| `PRICING.outputPerM` | `1.10` | USD per 1M completion tokens |
| `USD_"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"TO_CNY` | `7.2` | USD → CNY exchange rate |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`) registers a component into the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"reads the current session's `tokenUsage` projection.
- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers `GET"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" /api/deepseek-balance`, proxying DeepSeek's balance API with the stored key."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
